summary: Onconetix, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for a PIPE financing. On July 28, 2026, the company agreed to sell 37,812 shares of Series F convertible preferred stock to an accredited investor for $30,249,600 ($800 per share, a 20% discount to the $1,000 stated value). The preferred stock ranks junior to senior preferred, pari passu with Series C/D/E, and senior to common. A registration rights agreement was also executed. Structure involves convertible preferred with conversion features and associated overhang. What to watch: conversion mechanics, dilution impact on existing common shareholders, potential downward price pressure, and registration statement filing timing.
